subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should Claws use shared global plugin installs with advisory package references and warning-only uninstall behavior?
rationale: Implementation mechanics cannot decide whether operators may knowingly remove shared dependencies and leave Claws broken; that ownership and recovery contract affects later status, remove, update, and doctor behavior.

options.title: Approve advisory references
options.body: Keep shared installs and warning-only removal after the trust-ordering, canonical-persistence, and real-proof gates are resolved.

options.title: Require explicit force
options.body: Block removal of referenced plugins by default and require a deliberate override that accepts dependent Claw breakage.

options.title: Defer package mutation
options.body: Keep package operations read-only until the broader Claw lifecycle ownership contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve advisory references
recommendation.body: Keep shared installs and warning-only removal after the trust-ordering, canonical-persistence, and real-proof gates are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans the shared plugin-management and SQLite ownership surfaces needed for this cross-cutting product decision.
